messages:
sasha: Quick perf note: after the FP8 fallback landed for long-KV flows I'm seeing kernel-pick thrash on sm86. int8 <-> fp8 alternates every other batch under mixed seq distributions. anyone else?

Tariq: yep, reproduced locally on nightly with the same workload. small batches (2-8) + varying seq lengths triggers oscillation. dumping the profiler now.

perf-bot: automated profile attached:
```
model: decoder-only, batch=4
workload: mixed seq {64,256,512,1024}
arch: sm86
results:
  int8_kernel_v2: 1.80 ms/token
  fp8_kernel_v1: 1.75 ms/token
  kernel_switch_reinit: 0.90 ms (one-time per-context)
notes: oscillation window approx seq in [480..560]
```

megan: probably we need hysteresis on the kernel selector. switching cost (reinit) is non-trivial so small instantaneous wins shouldn't flip picks every batch. proposal: add per-arch hysteresis and a switch_penalty in the cost model. sample config: 
```yaml
autotune:
  - arch: sm86
    kernels:
      - name: int8_fast
        preferred_seqlen: [0,480]
        hysteresis: 64         # if current kernel is int8, require +64 tokens advantage to switch
      - name: fp8_lowmem
        preferred_seqlen: [481,4096]
        hysteresis: 128
    switch_penalty_ms: 0.9
```

Tariq: +1 to that. also add a "recent_switches" counter into the scoring so we can avoid flip-flopping across few batches. minimal pseudo: 
```
score(kernel) = est_latency_ms + switch_penalty_ms * switches_recent
choose kernel with min score
```

sasha: we also need per-arch tunables beyond hysteresis: workspace_limit_mb, shared_mem_budget, prefer_tensorcore_threshold. can we list sane defaults?

megan: here's what we've been using in experiments (empirical):
```
sm83:
  int8: {workspace_mb: 320, shared_mem_pct: 0.45, prefer_tensorcore: true}
  fp8: {workspace_mb: 240, shared_mem_pct: 0.40}
sm86:
  int8: {workspace_mb: 384, shared_mem_pct: 0.50, prefer_tensorcore: true}
  int4: {workspace_mb: 384, shared_mem_pct: 0.55}
  fp8: {workspace_mb: 256, shared_mem_pct: 0.42}
sm90:
  int8: {workspace_mb: 512, shared_mem_pct: 0.55, prefer_tensorcore: true}
  fp8: {workspace_mb: 320, shared_mem_pct: 0.48}
```
These are starting points — tune per-model.

Tariq: FYI there's a perf regression observed on sm83 int8 at seq=1024 after PR #4123 (quant-kernel-inline). baseline was ~1.9ms/token now 2.15ms/token. can someone bisect?

sasha: noted. I'll run a bisect tomorrow AM. short-term mitigation: selector should prefer the last-stable kernel unless candidate wins by >5% end-to-end token latency (not just per-op). that plus hysteresis should avoid hitting the regression in prod.

megan: also KV-cache interaction: when we switch kernel families we sometimes reallocate KV layout (different chunking). that reallocation amplifies the reinit cost. suggestion: tie kernel-family preference to kv_chunk_size so we reuse buffer layout more often. e.g. prefer kernels that use same kv_chunk_size or fallback to unified layout.

Tariq: agree. implementations notes: 
- add kernel_family tag to the selector state
- maintain last_used_kv_chunk_size per context
- add small penalty if kernel requires kv-layout-change

sasha: sounds good. can we prioritize: 1) add switch_penalty and hysteresis (sm86+), 2) scoring uses recent_switches, 3) add kv-layout penalty, 4) bisect sm83 PR. I'll open a short RFC with these steps and config knobs.

megan: ping me on the RFC, I'll add per-arch defaults and a small test harness to run the oscillation workloads.

perf-bot: Regression alert: sm83-int8 latency delta +13% at seq=1024 after commit 18f3c2. Disabled autopick on canary.

Tariq: ok that's helpful. thanks all. :thumbsup:

sasha: ok closing the loop for now. RFC + test harness + bisect. anyone wants to take the bisect ping me in the morning.
